name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Ashford goes with Poison or Ashford goes with Crowbar.

Exactly one of these is true: Ashford goes with Poison; Pierce goes with Reading; Ravenscroft goes with Writing.
